title: Upcoming payments
loadFailed: Could not load payments. Reload the page.
overdueHint: The calendar does not confirm a payment. If the charge already happened, confirm it or link an existing operation.

form.title: Title
form.amountHint: Leave empty if the amount is unknown

pay.title: Confirm payment
pay.settleHint: If the amount is below the plan, the rest is no longer expected
pay.linkHint: If the charge is already recorded, link it: no new operation is created.
pay.alreadyPaid: Someone else just updated this payment — nothing was doubled. Data is refreshed, check the state and try again.

cancelPayment.title: Cancel the payment?
cancelPayment.text: «{title}» becomes unpaid again with the date {date}. The operation below is deleted, the balance of «{account}» {direction, select, out {goes up} other {goes down}} by {amount}.
cancelPayment.deleteOperation: Also delete the operation this payment created
cancelPayment.deleteOperationHint: If the operation was linked, not created, turn it off — it stays.
cancelPayment.textCredit: Installment {number} of {total} of the credit «{title}» becomes unpaid again with the date {date}. The operation below is deleted, the balance of «{account}» {direction, select, out {goes up} other {goes down}} by {amount}.
cancelPayment.operationHint: If the charge happened but with another amount, edit the operation instead.

move.title: Change the payment date
move.text: «{title}»: the new date is for this payment only, the rest of the schedule stays.

empty.title: All paid
empty.text: No unpaid payments. New ones appear here as a subscription, installment or planned payment comes due.
empty.textShort: No unpaid payments. New ones appear here as a date comes close.

overdueHintViewer: The calendar does not confirm a payment. Only an owner or an editor of the space can confirm it.
offlineQueued: No connection. The payment «{title}» is saved on the device and will be sent when the network is back.
offlineQueuedMany: No connection. Payments saved on the device: {count}. They will be sent when the network is back.
